{{Quotation|game|Double-click to summon a [[Fire Imp (summon)|Fire Imp]] of your [[level]] that lasts for 60 minutes or until slain in combat. Summoning stones can only be activated once every 10 minutes per [[character]], and only one summoned [[ally]] from a summoning stone can be present in an [[instance]] at a time. This item has unlimited uses, cannot be used by level 20 characters, and can only be used in [[explorable area]]s.}}

==Acquisition==
Access to the Igneous Summoning Stone is granted to [[account]]s that have met at least ''one'' of the following requirements:
*Purchased [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]].
*Purchased any version of the Guild Wars game online, via the in-game store or PlayNC.com, before the release of [[Guild Wars Reforged]].
**Purchased [[Guild Wars Trilogy]] or [[Guild Wars: The Complete Collection]].
**Purchased a new version of any [[Guild Wars]] product in North America and Europe with a [[Fire Imp]] on the back of the box.
**Purchased the [[Guild Wars 2008 Upgrade]] available in the [[Guild Wars Online Store|official online store]].
**Purchased the [[1 Million Edition Upgrade]], available only via the online store.
If the above requirements have been met, any character on that account may create the item by typing the "/bonus" [[special command]] into the in-game [[chat window]] while in a town or outpost. As a [[bonus item]], the Igneous Summoning Stone can be created as many times as desired per account.

==Notes==
* With the release of Guild Wars Reforged, this add-on was made available via purchasing Guild Wars Eye of the North.
* If you have purchased all campaigns from a store other than the [[Guild Wars Online Store|Official Online Store]] (or [https://us.ncsoft.com NCsoft online account]) or the special [[Guild Wars: The Complete Collection]] pack, you have to buy the [[Guild Wars 2008 Upgrade]] or [[Game of the Year Upgrade]] in the [https://store.guildwars.com Online Store] add-ons section.
*Unlike other summoning stones, it can only be used by characters below level 20, and the summoned ally's duration is 60 minutes.
*The ten minute "cooldown" [[Summoning Sickness|debuff]] is removed upon changing zones, allowing it to be used freely for quick [[farming]] runs.
*The Imp is immune to [[Swamp Water]].
*Other than the hard-to-obtain [[Ascalonian War Horn]] and its [[Ascalonian War Horn (unique)|unique variant]], it is the only summoning stone available in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing]], making it an extremely useful tool there. Since it cannot be used by characters that are level 20, some players may for [[farming]] purposes refrain from attaining level 20 and Legendary [[Defender of Ascalon]] to keep their ability to use the stone.
